player.harness: tools/agents/jev.mjs JEV_MODE=score: code simulates each legal placement and describes it in words; Jev rates every candidate with one Score question (5 levels) in a single request per piece; code plays the highest expected score. No search beyond one piece, no hold.
player.notes: Jev is a System One decision model (typed answers, no text generation), so code does the simulation and Jev does the judging. Third decomposition tried on this seed: a single Choice over all placements scored 1,358; a board-only Choice with no features topped out at piece 10 with 206. Each mode was run once.
